sam.k: Hey infra — seeing missing child spans from payments-service (Go). Traces start at API gateway and show the root, but worker/async spans aren't appearing in Jaeger. We're using OpenTelemetry-Go 1.17 and OTLP->collector. Any quick checks? example trace id: 0af7651916cd43dd8448eb211c80319c

maya: A few quick things to rule out: 1) Check propagators (TextMapPropagator) — if headers aren't propagated the child spans won't be linked. 2) Confirm sampler: prod uses ParentBased+Ratio 0.05 so if parent was unsampled children won't be emitted. 3) Collector/Envoy could be stripping gRPC metadata.

jon: Can you paste your tracer init and env? Also which service process spawns the goroutine — are you passing ctx into it?

sam.k: Tracer init snippet is below:
```go
tp := sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(
  sdktrace.WithSampler(sdktrace.ParentBased(trace.TraceIDRatioBased(0.05))),
)
otel.SetTracerProvider(tp)
```
Env: `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://collector.internal:4318`, `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp_http`.

priya: Two likely causes: 1) Context propagation — if you `go func() { doWork() }()` without passing `ctx` you'll lose trace context. 2) Don't use `context.Background()` inside request handlers. Use the request ctx.

sam.k: Uh — we do have `go startWorker()` without any ctx param. That's on me, will change to `go startWorker(ctx)` and propagate.

obs-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tracing/span-loss — recommends enabling SDK debug logs and verifying propagator config. Also suggests using `otlp` debug in collector: `collector --log-level debug`.

jon: If that doesn't fix it, check collector sampling (tail-based) and also envoy/gateway config for `grpc` header passthrough. We had a bug that removed `traceparent` two weeks ago.

sam.k: Thanks — will push a patch. @maya can you review when I do? :thumbsup:

maya: Yep, PTAL. Also add an oteltest/InMemory exporter test that asserts spans are created for the async worker.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging deploy window tomorrow 03:00 UTC. If you need an immediate canary ping ops.

sam.k: Patch pushed (1773004879) — updated worker to accept ctx, passed context to tracer, added unit test verifying span creation.

jon: Saw the PR, LGTM as code-owner. CI passing, will merge after the normal wait.

sam.k: Merged and validated in Jaeger — child spans now visible and linked. Leaving this thread for visibility. Thanks everyone!
